ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Plants and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants and its resources.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dangers of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dangers of heat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dangers of heat.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dangers of heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmonious? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmonious.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmonious.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmonious.

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.

17. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.

19. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe in? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe in.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe in.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe in.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Heat and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of heat in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Dangers of heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Harmonious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Safe and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise projects environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Safe Travel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
